Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against human lethal malignant brain tumor-like protein 1. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target by name and organism. Join compound_structures to retrieve SMILES. Filter target_dictionary.pref_name for lethal malignant brain tumor-like protein 1 and target_dictionary.organism for Homo sapiens. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
